74cb8653a1971d3707c6bfd8614db10c3e5711f6.summary: A 2015 blog post by MobileIron (Michael T. Raggo, October 2015) on XARA, a group of iOS and OS X vulnerabilities reported by Indiana University researchers. It describes URL scheme hijacking, where a malicious app registers the same URL scheme as a legitimate app, intercepts inter-app requests, and can be used for phishing and credential theft. The researchers say their discoveries date back to fall 2014, and FireEye's Masque Attack II (February 2015) is cited as earlier work. Mitigations are MobileIron's AppConnect product and general iOS best practices.

74f9ea2e6d18b6e38364e1645f4b0d2620d01245.summary: Quorum Cyber's profile of Scattered Spider (also UNC3944 and Roasted 0ktapus), a financially motivated group active since at least May 2022. The report says the group gets initial access through stolen credentials from SMS and email phishing, has used Azure Serial Console to reach virtual machines, and uses a loader called STONESTOP to install the POORTRY signed driver in a bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver attack that terminates security software. It also reports phishing of other users via the employee database and lateral movement. Microsoft has not yet given the group a designation.

74daf0def052de0df4d05e5d0dee861d78c35826.summary: BleepingComputer reports that Chinese state-backed group Silk Typhoon (also called Hafnium) is linked to a hack of the U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) in early December. Attackers used a stolen Remote Support SaaS API key to compromise a BeyondTrust instance used by the Treasury and breach its network. The Office of Financial Research was also hacked, and its impact is still being assessed. CISA reportedly said the breach did not affect other federal agencies. The attribution rests on a Bloomberg report and unnamed sources.

Its main use is the FakeUpdate campaign, which uses fake browser update notices to deliver the NetSupport Client RAT. The campaign appears to have started in February 2022, with Parrot activity traced back to October 2021.
